tools.name: search_french_companies
tools.description: Use FIRST whenever a French company is mentioned by NAME without an identifier. French company search and company lookup by name or SIREN in the official French company registry (INSEE Sirene / INPI RNE data). Returns the top 10 matches, each with a score_confiance (0-1 match confidence) and a correspondance_nom, which together help pick among homonyms; total_results counts every match (tronque: true beyond the 10 served, note_troncature when it is a lower bound). Order: match level first, served as correspondance_nom (exacte: the name, the official name in the French search, equals q once the legal forms written for the result's country are removed at either end of both, never the last word, for the countries of the closed list of written legal forms, a GLEIF result from any other country keeping its whole name; mots_entiers: every remaining word of q is a word of the name; ressemblance: the rest, an acronym or other-field hit included; null if q is a SIREN, SIRET or the result's national ID, or no name is served), then an internal ranking score, not score_confiance (European search: score_confiance before its cap at 1 and its rounding; French search: the similarity of the name, usual name and acronym, plus 0.05 for an active company, the name and acronym only in the real-time fallback); ties: by SIREN in the French search, one country in turn in the European search (rank by national ID within each country, then country code). etages_abandonnes is always present: an empty array means the top 10 is complete; a non-empty one (with resultats_partiels: true) means the local index was degraded and the real-time fallback failed, so the list is partial: retry in a few seconds. If aucune_correspondance_fiable is true, no result resembles the name you asked for (best confidence < 0.5): do NOT treat the top hit as the company; check the spelling or retry. In the local index, typo tolerance only covers active companies under full disclosure: a ceased company, or one under partial disclosure, is found there by its exact name, its beginning or all its words. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): a name search leaves out a unit not proven to be a legal person, uncounted (total_results lowered); a SIREN or SIRET search serves it with denomination null, counted in ecartes.diffusion_partielle. Paid via x402 ($0.002 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

tools.name: prepare_french_einvoicing_recipient
tools.description: Use when you need to PREPARE a compliant French e-invoice for a company (invoice header, VAT number, addressing) rather than decide whether paying it is safe; for the full verify-the-supplier-before-payment verdict, IBAN included, call prepare_french_invoice_file. Preparation only: Sirenic is not an accredited platform (PDP), does not access the central directory and never issues, transmits or routes invoices, nor confirms PPF/PDP registration. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): a unit not proven to be a legal person has destinataire.denomination null, uncounted; destinataire.information states the partial diffusion. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

tools.name: get_french_company_default_risk
tools.description: Company default-risk score (0-100) for a French company at ~12 months: credit risk and insolvency risk scoring from filed financial ratios (structure, profitability, liquidity, net cash, debt service, trend) + company age + a hard BODACC override (active insolvency / liquidation / closure for insufficiency of assets = proven default). Returns score, qualitative band, every component with its threshold, and a confidence level. Decision-support only, NOT a solvency opinion or credit rating. Statistical indicator about the company, not a decision or an assessment about a person. `couverture_axes` names the axes the scale could evaluate and the silent ones with a closed-list reason (no published ratio, holding lens, single-year trend, uncovered line items, commercial-court decisions not read): a silent axis cannot penalise, so fewer computed axes means possibly understated risk, never a better score. Commercial-court decisions linked to the company are counted in `contentieux_informatif` (by nature and role, partial coverage: zero never means no litigation; `dernier_passage_complet` dates the collection's last full pass). One measured cell weighs (since scale version defaillance-v1.10, measured against a placebo): at least one order or judgment to pay as defendant dated within the twelve months before the day of computation adds 12 points for an SME (PME) only, never for a mid-cap, a large company or an unknown category (`contentieux_informatif.cellule`: count, points, closed-list reason); other decisions do not weigh. `echelle.backtest` carries the dated measurement of the scale on real French defaults (BODACC opening judgments from 31 December 2025 to 3 September 2026 joined with filed accounts, case-control design): AUC, share of defaults per band with confidence intervals, detection at the 25 and 50 thresholds. These are OBSERVED rates on a sample, never a probability of default for the company you are reading; `versions_couvertes` names the scale versions the measurement holds for. Fully disclosed legal persons only: a sole proprietorship, a restricted-diffusion unit or a group without legal personality is refused, 400 with the exact code, never charged. Paid via x402 ($0.10 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

tools.name: get_french_company_default_risk_batch
tools.description: Use when asked to rank customers or suppliers by default risk, e.g. "Rank my customers by risk and monitor the 30 most exposed." Batch default-risk score for 2 to 100 French companies in one call: each line carries the SAME score, class, confidence and model version as get_french_company_default_risk (one scorecard), in a closed-list basket: expose, a_surveiller, sain, non_evaluable (with its cause), cessee (a ceased company always goes there, whatever its class). Lines are ordered by basket, then by exact axis set (jeu_axes, index into jeux_axes: two scores computed on different axes are never ranked against each other), then by score; motifs_principaux names the at most three scorecard axes that weigh most; a line whose reference year is not exploitable carries qualite_exercice_reference (fiabilite, anomalies): read it before the score. The head counts the non_evaluable lines per cause (non_evaluable_par_cause). An unknown SIREN is a billed line (trouve=false, cause siren_inconnu), and so is one whose identity is incomplete (cause identite_incomplete, with champs_absents and fiche); no line scored at all: 404, not charged, lignes naming each cause (error identite_incomplete when every SIREN is incomplete); BODACC down: the whole batch is cancelled (503), not charged. No officer, no free text; the name only for a legal entity. Statistical indicator about the company, not a decision or an assessment about a person. chainage.surveillance lists the WHOLE expose basket in served order (axis set, then score; 100 at most, never a ceased company) with the 30-day quote of create_surveillance_watch for that list: $0.05 per target x targets. To monitor the first N only, pass its first N SIRENs to create_surveillance_watch (quoted N x $0.05): a separate watch, paid on its own, checked daily, never real time. A batch holding such a SIREN (sole proprietorship, restricted diffusion, group without legal personality) is refused whole: 400, never charged, sirens_refuses gives each refused SIREN and its code; replay without them. Paid via x402 ($0.07 per SIREN in USDC or EURC, 30% off the unit score). Closed lists and reading rules: GET /v1/lecture (free). A full-size request quotes up to $7.00, above the $1.00 single-payment cap that x402 clients apply BY DEFAULT since @x402/core 2.23 (spendControls): raise spendControls.maxAmountPerPayment, or set spendControls: false, before signing; otherwise your own client rejects the quote without ever calling us. When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

Statistical indicator about the company, not a decision or an assessment about a person. tools.name: search_eu_financial_authorisations
tools.description: Search EU financial authorisations in five official registers by name or LEI: ESMA Registers (MiFID-regulated entities across all EU/EEA countries: status, home and host member states, competent authority, dates), the ECB list of supervised entities (`supervision_bce`: banking union, significant banks under direct ECB supervision and less significant ones under national authorities, group, remarks, monthly changes; absence is conclusive only for a LEI and never means unsupervised outside the banking union), the ESMA register of benchmark administrators (`administrateurs_indices`), the ESMA register of money market funds (`fonds_monetaires`: fund and manager LEI, type, domicile, authorisation status incl. Withdrawn, dates) and the EIOPA register of occupational pension institutions (`iorp`: national authority, registration dates incl. closed registrations, cross-border activity, managing entity; only 30% carry a LEI, so zero by LEI is never conclusive). A block listed in `blocs_absents` was not read: panne_amont (retry later), stock_perime or collecte_en_cours (local copy too old or never loaded: retrying does not help). Use to verify that a financial firm is actually regulated somewhere in the EU. Data freely available at the sources. An entry whose own name, trading name or manager (money market funds, IORPs) is under objection (GDPR art. 21) is neither served nor counted, with no ecartes field; `nombre_total` (top level or of a block) may be null, unknown, when an ESMA register's matches under such an objection cannot all be re-read, or their re-read failed (such a page is not cached: the next call reads the register again; GET /v1/lecture), and an item of `supervision_bce.entites[].changements` is null when it names a person who objected, counted in the entity's ecartes.opposition. An ESMA MiFID entry run by a natural person (a written natural-person mark such as e.K., v/ or sole trader, or a LEI that GLEIF calls a natural person) or in doubt (an ambiguous LEI legal form, or an investment firm with neither a LEI known to GLEIF nor a written legal-person form) is never served: it is left out and counted without identity in `agrements_omis` (personne_physique, forme_juridique_non_reconnue), and stays counted in `nombre_total`; when GLEIF cannot be read for the page, 503, not charged. tools.name: validate_eu_vat_number
tools.description: VAT number check against VIES: use when you only need the tax half of verifying a supplier before payment: confirm that a counterparty's intra-community VAT number really exists before invoicing it, applying the reverse charge or paying it. It is a required check under the French e-invoicing mandate of 1 September 2026 and under the Belgian B2B mandate in force since 1 January 2026. Validates any EU intra-community VAT number against the official VIES service (all member states) and returns valid or invalid, the registered name and address when the member state publishes them, and the VIES consultation identifier as proof. Name and address are served only for a holder that its number's format or its country's register (BE, PL, LV, HR, RO, SE, CZ, DK, FI, FR) proves a legal person; any other holder (natural person, undecided form, missing from its register, or in a state where no register qualifies it: AT, CY, DE, EE, EL, HU, IE, IT, LT, LU, MT, NL, SI, SK, XI) gets neither, the omission counted in ecartes by reason. A register that cannot qualify the holder (down, quota reached, or its local copy not yet built: cause collecte_en_cours) leaves both out as a doubt, says its register and cause in qualification_en_echec, and nothing is cached. A VIES outage (member state down or saturated) returns error 503 amont_indisponible, not charged: retry later; never a false invalid. The response is Ed25519-signed and carries provenance[]: the VIES entry with the date the number was really consulted, never a fabricated one. Paid via x402 ($0.003 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
